script_text: Gemini, Jupiter squares your natal Pluto this week, so everything around you feels completely different now. By Wednesday Mercury squares Saturn in your 10th House, causing career delays, testing patience. Thursday shifts everything as the Sun conjoins Venus in your 5th House, unlocking passionate romance and fearless creative energy. Late week Mars enters your 7th House, spotlighting partnership dynamics. The weekend Moon in Aquarius, an Air sign, rewards candid healing and deep conversations. Thursday is your power day because Jupiter trines Pluto in your 8th House, unlocking hidden transformation and money insight. Wednesday is your weakest day because Mercury hard squares Saturn in your 10th House, frustrating career progress entirely. Gemini, trust your instincts Thursday on romance and hold work negotiations until late in the week. Follow for daily updates.
